<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="JU YEON LEE Portfolio — Sports, Entertainment, IP Business &amp; Strategy" name="description"/>
<title>JU YEON LEE | PORTFOLIO</title>
<style>
    :root {
      --blue: #0757d5;
      --blue-dark: #063b91;
      --blue-light: #eaf2ff;
      --ink: #111827;
      --muted: #6b7280;
      --line: #dfe6f0;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --bg: #f7f9fc;
      --max: 1280px;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: Inter, Pretendard, "Noto Sans KR", Arial, sans-serif;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { font: inherit; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    .container {
      width: min(calc(100% - 48px), var(--max));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* NAV */
    .nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(223,230,240,.8);
    }
    .nav-inner {
      height: 72px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .logo {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
    }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #4b5563;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--blue); }

    /* HERO */
    .hero {
      min-height: 92vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 140px 0 90px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 82% 28%, rgba(7,87,213,.12), transparent 26%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff 0%, #f8fbff 100%);
    }
    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: end;
    }
    .eyebrow {
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(54px, 9vw, 128px);
      line-height: .92;
      letter-spacing: -.065em;
      font-weight: 900;
      max-width: 1000px;
    }
    .hero h1 span { color: var(--blue); }
    .hero-desc {
      max-width: 520px;
      margin-top: 34px;
      color: #4b5563;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -.02em;
    }
    .hero-meta {
      border-left: 2px solid var(--blue);
      padding-left: 20px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #4b5563;
    }
    .hero-meta strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 15px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    /* SECTION */
    section { padding: 120px 0; }
    .section-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: end;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .section-no {
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(34px, 5vw, 62px);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -.045em;
    }
    .section-desc {
      max-width: 420px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    /* PROFILE */
    .profile {
      background: var(--bg);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .profile-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr;
      gap: 70px;
    }
    .photo-placeholder {
      aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
      border: 1px dashed #9fb4d5;
      background: #edf3fb;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      color: #7790b3;
      font-size: 13px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .photo-placeholder::before {
      content: "PHOTO";
      font-size: 42px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      opacity: .16;
    }
    .profile-info {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 42px 70px;
    }
    .info-block h3 {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--blue);
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .info-block p, .info-block li {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #374151;
    }
    .info-block ul { list-style: none; }
    .info-block li + li { margin-top: 9px; }
    .info-block li span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      display: block;
    }

    /* COMPETENCY */
    .competency-list {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .competency-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .competency-button {
      width: 100%;
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      padding: 30px 4px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
    }
    .competency-button:hover .comp-title { color: var(--blue); }
    .comp-no {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--blue);
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .comp-title {
      font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 38px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -.035em;
      transition: color .2s;
    }
    .comp-arrow {
      font-size: 25px;
      color: var(--muted);
      transition: transform .25s;
    }
    .competency-item.open .comp-arrow { transform: rotate(45deg); }
    .comp-detail {
      display: none;
      padding: 0 0 35px 90px;
    }
    .competency-item.open .comp-detail { display: block; }
    .project-mini-list {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 12px 30px;
      max-width: 900px;
    }
    .mini-project {
      padding: 17px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .mini-project strong { display: block; font-size: 15px; }
    .mini-project span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; display: block; margin-top: 3px; }

    /* PROJECTS */
    .projects {
      background: #0b2f69;
      color: white;
    }
    .projects .section-no { color: #82b2ff; }
    .projects .section-desc { color: #b9c8df; }
    .project-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }
    .project-card {
      min-height: 220px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      padding: 28px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform .25s, background .25s;
    }
    .project-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.09);
    }
    .project-card.featured {
      grid-column: span 2;
      min-height: 300px;
    }
    .project-tag {
      color: #9ec5ff;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
    }
    .project-card h3 {
      font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 48px);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -.045em;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    .project-card p {
      max-width: 560px;
      color: #c9d5e7;
      font-size: 13px;
      margin-top: 15px;
    }
    .project-bottom {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: end;
      padding-top: 30px;
    }
    .project-index {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #8ea9cf;
    }
    .project-link {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* DETAIL PLACEHOLDER */
    .detail {
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .detail-box {
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: #fbfcff;
      padding: 38px;
    }
    .detail-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 40px;
    }
    .image-slot {
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      border: 1px dashed #9fb4d5;
      background: var(--blue-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #7691b9;
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
    }
    .detail-copy h3 {
      font-size: 30px;
      line-height: 1.05;
      margin-bottom: 25px;
    }
    .detail-copy dl { display: grid; gap: 17px; }
    .detail-copy dt {
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
    }
    .detail-copy dd {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #4b5563;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* CASE STUDY */
    .case-study-intro {
      max-width: 760px;
      color: #4b5563;
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }
    .case-study-stack {
      display: grid;
      gap: 28px;
    }
    .case-study-card {
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: #fff;
      padding: 42px;
      scroll-margin-top: 100px;
    }
    .case-study-card.active {
      border-color: #a9c6f4;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(7,87,213,.08);
    }
    .case-study-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr .95fr;
      gap: 42px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .case-study-number {
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .14em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .case-study-card h3 {
      font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 56px);
      line-height: .98;
      letter-spacing: -.05em;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .case-study-summary {
      color: #4b5563;
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      max-width: 620px;
    }
    .case-study-role {
      margin-top: 25px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      background: var(--blue-light);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--blue);
    }
    .case-study-role strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }
    .case-study-role span {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #253858;
    }
    .case-study-image {
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
      border: 1px dashed #9fb4d5;
      background: #eef4fc;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #7892b8;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .case-study-image img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
    .case-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1px;
      background: var(--line);
      margin-top: 38px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .case-stat {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 22px;
    }
    .case-stat .value {
      display: block;
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: clamp(25px, 3vw, 38px);
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
    }
    .case-stat .label {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
    }
    .case-sections {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 34px 60px;
      margin-top: 42px;
    }
    .case-section {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      padding-top: 18px;
    }
    .case-section h4 {
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .case-section p,
    .case-section li {
      color: #4b5563;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }
    .case-section ul {
      padding-left: 18px;
    }
    .case-section li + li {
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .case-highlight {
      grid-column: span 2;
      background: #f5f8fd;
      border: 1px solid #e3eaf5;
      padding: 24px;
    }
    .case-highlight strong {
      color: var(--ink);
      display: block;
      font-size: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
    }
    .case-highlight p {
      margin: 0;
    }
    .experience-strip {
      margin-top: 35px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .experience-strip .strip-item {
      padding: 22px;
      background: #0b2f69;
      color: white;
    }
    .strip-item small {
      color: #9ec5ff;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
    }
    .strip-item strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 18px;
      margin-top: 5px;
    }
    .strip-item span {
      display: block;
      color: #c9d5e7;
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    /* EMBEDDED BRAND VISUALS */
    .photo-placeholder.has-photo {
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    .photo-placeholder.has-photo::before { display: none; }
    .photo-placeholder.has-photo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center bottom;
      display: block;
    }

    .hero-brand-mark {
      width: 138px;
      margin: 0 0 24px;
      padding: 13px 18px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: #0b2f69;
    }
    .hero-brand-mark img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 34px;
      object-fit: contain;
      display: block;
    }

    .visual-project-grid { align-items: stretch; }
    .project-card.visual-card,
    .project-card.visual-card.featured {
      min-height: 0;
      padding: 0;
      display: block;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    }
    .project-card.visual-card.featured { grid-column: span 2; }
    .project-logo-wrap {
      height: 220px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 38px;
      background: #f8fafc;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .project-card.featured .project-logo-wrap { height: 290px; }
    .project-logo-wrap.dark {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, #0e58b9 0%, #072b64 58%, #041a3a 100%);
    }
    .project-logo-wrap.black { background: #050505; }
    .project-logo-wrap.light { background: #fff; }
    .project-logo-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      max-width: 92%;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      display: block;
    }
    .project-logo-wrap.image-cover { padding: 0; background: #090909; }
    .project-logo-wrap.image-cover img {
      max-width: none;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center 42%;
    }
    .project-card.visual-card h3 {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 20px 22px 22px;
      color: #fff;
      background: #0b2f69;
      font-size: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 30px);
      line-height: 1.05;
      min-height: 76px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .project-card.visual-card:hover h3 { background: #0f438e; }

    .case-study-image.brand-visual {
      border: 0;
      padding: 32px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .case-study-image.brand-visual.dark {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, #0e58b9 0%, #072b64 58%, #041a3a 100%);
    }
    .case-study-image.brand-visual.black { background: #050505; }
    .case-study-image.brand-visual.light { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .case-study-image.brand-visual img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      display: block;
    }
    .case-study-image.brand-visual.cover { padding: 0; background: #090909; }
    .case-study-image.brand-visual.cover img { object-fit: cover; object-position: center 42%; }


    /* UNIFIED CASE STUDY SYSTEM */
    .case-study-card{
      padding:48px;
      border:0;
      background:#fff;
      border-radius:22px;
      box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(9,35,73,.12);
      overflow:hidden;
    }

    .case-study-head,
    .case-study-top,
    .case-top{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(240px,.75fr);
      gap:34px;
      align-items:center;
      margin-bottom:30px;
    }

    .case-study-heading h3,
    .case-study-card h3{
      margin:6px 0 14px;
      font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,58px);
      line-height:1;
      letter-spacing:-.05em;
      color:#0f172a;
    }

    .case-study-heading p,
    .case-lead,
    .case-study-summary{
      max-width:720px;
      margin:0;
      color:#5b6473;
      font-size:15px;
      line-height:1.75;
    }

    .case-eyebrow,
    .case-company,
    .case-study-number{
      color:var(--blue);
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:800;
      letter-spacing:.14em;
    }

    .case-study-logo{
      min-height:170px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      padding:28px;
      border-radius:18px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#071b49,#0d4d9a);
    }

    .case-study-logo img{
      width:100%;
      max-width:310px;
      max-height:120px;
      object-fit:contain;
    }

    .case-role,
    .case-study-role{
      padding:22px 24px;
      border-radius:16px;
      border:1px solid #dce7f7;
      background:#f7faff;
    }

    .case-role span,
    .case-study-role strong{
      display:block;
      margin-bottom:7px;
      color:var(--blue);
      font-size:10px;
      font-weight:800;
      letter-spacing:.12em;
    }

    .case-role strong,
    .case-study-role span{
      color:#172033;
      font-size:15px;
      line-height:1.5;
    }

    .case-metrics,
    .case-kpis,
    .case-stats{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
      gap:12px;
      margin:0 0 34px;
      background:transparent;
      border:0;
    }

    .case-metric,
    .case-kpis>div,
    .case-stat{
      padding:20px;
      border:1px solid #e3eaf3;
      border-radius:14px;
      background:#fbfcff;
    }

    .case-metric span,
    .case-kpis span,
    .case-stat .label{
      display:block;
      color:#7a8495;
      font-size:10px;
      font-weight:700;
      letter-spacing:.08em;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }

    .case-metric strong,
    .case-kpis strong,
    .case-stat .value{
      display:block;
      color:var(--blue);
      font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,31px);
      line-height:1.05;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:-.04em;
    }

    .case-metric small,
    .case-kpis small{
      display:block;
      margin-top:7px;
      color:#798294;
      font-size:11px;
    }

    .case-photo-feature{
      position:relative;
      margin:0 0 38px;
      overflow:hidden;
      border-radius:18px;
      background:#081d46;
      aspect-ratio:16/7.4;
    }

    .case-photo-feature img{
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      object-fit:cover;
      object-position:center;
      display:block;
    }

    .case-photo-feature::after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      inset:45% 0 0;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(5,20,46,.86));
    }

    .case-photo-overlay{
      position:absolute;
      z-index:2;
      left:28px;
      right:28px;
      bottom:24px;
      color:#fff;
    }

    .case-photo-overlay span{
      display:block;
      margin-bottom:7px;
      color:#79f0e4;
      font-size:10px;
      font-weight:800;
      letter-spacing:.12em;
    }

    .case-photo-overlay strong{
      font-size:22px;
      line-height:1.35;
    }

    .case-content-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
      gap:16px;
      margin-bottom:38px;
    }

    .case-content-block,
    .case-section{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:38px minmax(0,1fr);
      gap:14px;
      align-items:start;
      padding:24px;
      border:1px solid #e5eaf2;
      border-radius:16px;
      background:#fff;
    }

    .case-content-no{
      color:#9eb8df;
      font-size:13px;
      font-weight:900;
    }

    .case-content-block h4,
    .case-section h4{
      margin:0 0 10px;
      color:#102e62;
      font-size:14px;
      letter-spacing:.04em;
    }

    .case-content-block p,
    .case-section p,
    .case-section li,
    .case-content-block li{
      color:#5e6775;
      font-size:13px;
      line-height:1.75;
    }

    .case-content-block ul,
    .case-section ul{
      margin:12px 0 0;
      padding-left:18px;
    }

    .case-content-block li+li,
    .case-section li+li{
      margin-top:5px;
    }

    .case-photo-strip{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1.3fr .7fr;
      gap:0;
      margin-bottom:34px;
      overflow:hidden;
      border-radius:18px;
      border:1px solid #e3e8f0;
      background:#071a43;
    }

    .case-photo-strip figure{
      margin:0;
      min-height:360px;
      background:#eef4fb;
    }

    .case-photo-strip img{
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      min-height:360px;
      display:block;
      object-fit:cover;
      object-position:center;
    }

    .case-photo-note{
      padding:34px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      justify-content:center;
      color:#fff;
    }

    .case-photo-note span{
      color:#65e5dd;
      font-size:10px;
      font-weight:800;
      letter-spacing:.12em;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }

    .case-photo-note strong{
      font-size:22px;
      line-height:1.45;
    }

    .case-photo-note p{
      margin-top:14px;
      color:#c6d2e6;
      font-size:13px;
      line-height:1.7;
    }

    .case-impact-banner,
    .case-highlight{
      padding:26px 28px;
      border:0;
      border-radius:16px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eef5ff,#f8fbff);
      grid-column:auto;
    }

    .case-impact-banner span,
    .case-highlight strong{
      display:block;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      color:var(--blue);
      font-size:10px;
      font-weight:800;
      letter-spacing:.12em;
    }

    .case-impact-banner strong{
      display:block;
      color:#102e62;
      font-size:20px;
      line-height:1.4;
    }

    .case-impact-banner p,
    .case-highlight p{
      margin:8px 0 0;
      color:#596474;
      font-size:13px;
      line-height:1.7;
    }

    /* Normalize legacy case-study images to the same clean visual language */
    .case-study-image,
    .case-study-image.brand-visual,
    .case-visual,
    .swim-visual{
      border-radius:16px;
      overflow:hidden;
      border:1px solid #e3e8f0;
      box-shadow:none;
      background:#f5f8fc;
    }

    .case-study-image img,
    .case-study-image.brand-visual img,
    .case-visual img,
    .swim-visual img{
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      object-fit:contain;
      object-position:center;
    }

    .case-gallery,
    .swim-gallery{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
      gap:16px;
      margin:0 0 34px;
    }

    .case-gallery .wide,
    .swim-gallery .wide{
      grid-column:1/-1;
    }

    .case-visual figcaption,
    .swim-visual figcaption{
      padding:16px 18px 18px;
      background:#fff;
    }

    .case-visual figcaption strong,
    .swim-visual figcaption strong{
      display:block;
      color:var(--blue);
      font-size:10px;
      letter-spacing:.1em;
      margin-bottom:6px;
    }

    .case-visual figcaption span,
    .swim-visual figcaption span{
      color:#626b7a;
      font-size:12px;
      line-height:1.6;
    }

    .project-modal-inner{
      border-radius:24px;
      overflow:visible;
      background:transparent;
      box-shadow:none;
    }

    .project-modal-content{
      padding:8px;
    }

    @media(max-width:850px){
      .case-study-card{padding:26px;border-radius:16px}
      .case-study-head,.case-study-top,.case-top{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .case-metrics,.case-kpis,.case-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
      .case-content-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .case-photo-feature{aspect-ratio:4/3}
      .case-photo-strip{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .case-photo-strip figure,.case-photo-strip img{min-height:0;height:auto}
      .case-gallery,.swim-gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .case-gallery .wide,.swim-gallery .wide{grid-column:auto}
    }

    /* PROJECT DETAIL MODAL */
    .detail { display: none; }

    .project-modal {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 400;
      display: none;
      background: rgba(7, 20, 43, .68);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 28px;
    }

    .project-modal.is-open { display: block; }

    .project-modal-inner {
      width: min(1120px, 100%);
      margin: 28px auto;
      background: #fff;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
    }

    .project-modal-close {
      position: sticky;
      top: 18px;
      float: right;
      z-index: 10;
      width: 46px;
      height: 46px;
      margin: 18px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
      color: var(--ink);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 24px;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .project-modal-close:hover {
      color: var(--blue);
      border-color: #9fbef0;
    }

    .project-modal-content .case-study-card {
      border: 0;
      box-shadow: none;
      margin: 0;
    }

    body.modal-open { overflow: hidden; }

    /* FOOTER */
    footer {
      padding: 65px 0;
      background: #061b3c;
      color: white;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: end;
    }
    .footer-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -.05em;
    }
    .footer-copy { color: #9fb2ce; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 10px; }
    .footer-right { color: #9fb2ce; font-size: 12px; text-align: right; }

    /* RESPONSIVE */
    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .hero-grid, .profile-grid, .detail-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero { min-height: auto; }
      .profile-grid { gap: 40px; }
      .profile-info { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 30px; }
      .project-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .project-card.featured { grid-column: span 1; }
      .project-mini-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .comp-detail { padding-left: 0; }
      .footer-inner { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .footer-right { text-align: left; }
      .case-study-top, .case-sections { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .case-highlight { grid-column: span 1; }
      .case-stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .experience-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .case-study-card { padding: 28px; }
    }
  
    /* =========================================================
       CASE STUDY FINAL UI SYSTEM — CONSISTENT ACROSS ALL PROJECTS
       ========================================================= */

    /* Modal frame */
    .project-modal {
      padding: 32px 20px;
      background: rgba(4, 16, 39, .74);
    }

    .project-modal-inner {
      width: min(1100px, calc(100% - 16px));
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 28px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
    }

    .project-modal-content {
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff;
    }

    .project-modal-close {
      position: sticky;
      top: 14px;
      float: right;
      z-index: 30;
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      margin: 16px 16px -60px 0;
      border: 1px solid #dfe6f0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.12);
      color: #334155;
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    /* Every case study uses the same container, rhythm and spacing */
    .project-modal-content .case-study-card {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 56px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 0;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .project-modal-content .case-study-card > * + * {
      margin-top: 36px;
    }

    /* Top area */
    .case-study-top,
    .case-study-head,
    .case-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.45fr) minmax(250px, .55fr);
      gap: 42px;
      align-items: center;
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 34px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e7ecf3;
    }

    .case-study-number,
    .case-eyebrow,
    .case-company {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 28px;
      margin: 0 0 14px !important;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      background: #edf4ff;
      color: #0757d5;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .case-study-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 16px !important;
      color: #0f172a;
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4.2vw, 58px);
      line-height: 1.02;
      letter-spacing: -.05em;
    }

    .case-study-summary,
    .case-study-heading > p,
    .case-lead {
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 !important;
      color: #647083;
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }

    .case-study-role,
    .case-role {
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 22px 24px;
      border: 1px solid #dfe8f5;
      border-left: 4px solid #0757d5;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: #f8fbff;
    }

    .case-study-role strong,
    .case-role > span {
      display: block;
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: #0757d5;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
    }

    .case-study-role span,
    .case-role strong {
      display: block;
      color: #24324a;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    /* KPI rows */
    .case-stats,
    .case-kpis,
    .case-metrics {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
    }

    .case-stat,
    .case-kpis > div,
    .case-metric {
      min-height: 118px;
      padding: 20px 18px;
      border: 1px solid #e4eaf2;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: #fbfcfe;
    }

    .case-stat .label,
    .case-kpis span,
    .case-metric span {
      display: block;
      margin: 0 0 9px;
      color: #8a94a4;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .11em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .case-stat .value,
    .case-kpis strong,
    .case-metric strong {
      display: block;
      color: #0757d5;
      font-size: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 30px);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
    }

    .case-kpis small,
    .case-metric small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: #7a8493;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* ---------- NUMBERED SUBHEADERS ---------- */

    /* Custom cases: 01 / BUSINESS STRATEGY, etc. */
    .case-label {
      display: inline-flex !important;
      align-items: center;
      align-self: start;
      width: fit-content;
      min-height: 34px;
      margin: 0 0 14px !important;
      padding: 8px 12px !important;
      border: 1px solid #cfe0f8;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #edf5ff;
      color: #0757d5 !important;
      font-size: 10px !important;
      font-weight: 900 !important;
      line-height: 1 !important;
      letter-spacing: .1em !important;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Legacy cases: automatically number IP DEVELOPMENT / SPONSORSHIP etc. */
    .case-sections {
      counter-reset: legacy-case-section;
      display: grid !important;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)) !important;
      gap: 18px !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .case-sections > .case-section {
      counter-increment: legacy-case-section;
    }

    .case-sections > .case-section > h4 {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      width: fit-content;
      min-height: 34px;
      margin: 0 0 16px !important;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border: 1px solid #cfe0f8;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #edf5ff;
      color: #0757d5 !important;
      font-size: 10px !important;
      font-weight: 900 !important;
      line-height: 1 !important;
      letter-spacing: .1em !important;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .case-sections > .case-section > h4::before {
      content: "0" counter(legacy-case-section) " / ";
      margin-right: 4px;
      color: #0757d5;
    }

    /* Section cards: same spacing everywhere */
    .case-section,
    .case-content-block {
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 26px 28px !important;
      border: 1px solid #e4eaf2 !important;
      border-radius: 16px !important;
      background: #fff !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    /* Custom section markup is vertical, not awkward split-grid */
    .case-section {
      display: block !important;
    }

    .case-section .case-copy h4,
    .case-content-block h4 {
      margin: 0 0 10px !important;
      color: #172033 !important;
      font-size: 17px !important;
      font-weight: 800 !important;
      line-height: 1.4 !important;
      letter-spacing: -.02em !important;
    }

    .case-section p,
    .case-content-block p,
    .case-section li,
    .case-content-block li,
    .case-bullets span {
      color: #626d7c !important;
      font-size: 13px !important;
      line-height: 1.75 !important;
    }

    .case-section p,
    .case-content-block p {
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .case-section ul,
    .case-content-block ul {
      margin: 14px 0 0 !important;
      padding-left: 18px !important;
    }

    .case-section li + li,
    .case-content-block li + li {
      margin-top: 7px !important;
    }

    /* SOOPers custom section rhythm */
    #case-soopers > .case-section {
      margin-top: 18px !important;
    }

    #case-soopers > .case-gallery + .case-section,
    #case-soopers > .case-section + .case-gallery {
      margin-top: 28px !important;
    }

    /* Swim Fest content blocks */
    .case-content-grid {
      display: grid !important;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)) !important;
      gap: 18px !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .case-content-block {
      display: block !important;
      position: relative;
      padding-top: 58px !important;
    }

    .case-content-no {
      position: absolute;
      top: 22px;
      left: 28px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-width: 30px;
      height: 26px;
      padding: 0 8px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      background: #edf5ff;
      color: #0757d5 !important;
      font-size: 10px !important;
      font-weight: 900 !important;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
    }

    /* Images: consistent, restrained, clean */
    .case-gallery,
    .swim-gallery {
      display: grid !important;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)) !important;
      gap: 16px !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .case-visual,
    .swim-visual,
    .case-study-image {
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid #e4eaf2 !important;
      border-radius: 16px !important;
      background: #f6f8fb !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .case-visual img,
    .swim-visual img,
    .case-study-image img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain !important;
      object-position: center !important;
    }

    .case-visual:not(.live-reference) img {
      max-height: 390px;
    }

    .case-visual.wide {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    .case-visual.wide img {
      max-height: 430px;
    }

    .case-visual figcaption,
    .swim-visual figcaption {
      padding: 16px 18px 18px !important;
      background: #fff;
    }

    .case-visual figcaption strong,
    .swim-visual figcaption strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: #0757d5;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
    }

    .case-visual figcaption span,
    .swim-visual figcaption span {
      color: #687385;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .case-photo-feature,
    .case-photo-strip {
      margin: 0 !important;
      border: 1px solid #e4eaf2;
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .case-photo-feature {
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 7.2;
    }

    .case-photo-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.35fr .65fr;
      background: #071a43;
    }

    /* Impact/footer blocks */
    .case-highlight,
    .case-impact-banner,
    .case-impact {
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 24px 26px !important;
      border: 1px solid #dce8f8 !important;
      border-radius: 16px !important;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg,#f1f6ff,#fbfdff) !important;
    }

    .case-highlight strong,
    .case-impact-banner > span {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: #0757d5 !important;
      font-size: 10px !important;
      font-weight: 900 !important;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
    }

    .case-impact-banner > strong {
      color: #15315e;
      font-size: 20px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* Project card logo: Swim Fest white logo gets a dark-blue field */
    .project-card[onclick="openProject('race')"] .project-logo-wrap {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg,#071c49,#0b4b92) !important;
      padding: 34px !important;
    }

    .project-card[onclick="openProject('race')"] .project-logo-wrap img {
      max-width: 86% !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
    }

    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .project-modal { padding: 10px; }

      .project-modal-inner {
        width: 100%;
        border-radius: 18px;
      }

      .project-modal-content .case-study-card {
        padding: 30px 22px;
      }

      .case-study-top,
      .case-study-head,
      .case-top {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 22px;
        padding-bottom: 26px;
      }

      .case-stats,
      .case-kpis,
      .case-metrics,
      .case-sections,
      .case-content-grid,
      .case-gallery,
      .swim-gallery {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      }

      .case-visual.wide {
        grid-column: auto;
      }

      .case-photo-feature {
        aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
      }

      .case-photo-strip {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .case-photo-strip img {
        height: auto !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================
       FINAL V7 — GLOBAL CASE STUDY SPACING & BDMNTN XL VISUALS
       ========================================================== */

    /* Hard reset inconsistent child margins inside all popups */
    .project-modal-content .case-study-card {
      --case-gap-lg: 36px;
      --case-gap-md: 24px;
      --case-gap-sm: 14px;
      padding: 56px !important;
    }

    .project-modal-content .case-study-card > * {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .project-modal-content .case-study-card > * + * {
      margin-top: var(--case-gap-lg) !important;
    }

    /* Top section always same height/rhythm */
    .case-study-head,
    .case-study-top,
    .case-top {
      min-height: 190px;
      padding: 0 0 34px !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e7ecf3;
    }

    /* Metric row always same spacing */
    .case-metrics,
    .case-kpis,
    .case-stats {
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    /* Main body group rhythm */
    .case-content-grid,
    .case-sections,
    .case-gallery,
    .swim-gallery,
    .bdmntn-gallery,
    .case-photo-feature,
    .case-photo-strip,
    .case-impact-banner,
    .case-highlight,
    .case-impact {
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    /* Every body card equal internal whitespace */
    .case-content-block,
    .case-section {
      padding: 28px !important;
      min-height: 250px;
    }

    .case-content-block > div,
    .case-section .case-copy {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .case-content-block h4,
    .case-section .case-copy h4,
    .case-sections > .case-section > h4 {
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .case-content-block p,
    .case-section p,
    .case-section .case-copy p {
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .case-content-block ul,
    .case-section ul {
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    /* Keep section numbering visually distinct and consistently positioned */
    .case-content-block {
      position: relative;
      padding-top: 68px !important;
    }

    .case-content-no {
      top: 26px !important;
      left: 28px !important;
      min-width: 38px;
      height: 30px;
      padding: 0 10px;
      border: 1px solid #d7e6fb;
      background: #eef5ff;
      color: #0757d5 !important;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(7,87,213,.02);
    }

    .case-label,
    .case-sections > .case-section > h4 {
      min-height: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 16px !important;
    }

    /* Legacy case sections also receive equal card height */
    .case-sections > .case-section {
      min-height: 250px;
    }

    /* Images align to a common visual system */
    .case-photo-feature {
      min-height: 390px;
      max-height: 470px;
    }

    .case-photo-feature img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .case-gallery,
    .swim-gallery {
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .case-visual,
    .swim-visual {
      min-height: 330px;
    }

    /* ---------- BDMNTN XL ---------- */
    .bdmntn-logo-box {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgba(255,129,56,.18), transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(135deg,#171717,#060606) !important;
    }

    .project-card[onclick="openProject('bdmntn')"] .project-logo-wrap {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 44%, rgba(255,132,49,.14), transparent 42%),
        #070707 !important;
      padding: 38px !important;
    }

    .project-card[onclick="openProject('bdmntn')"] .project-logo-wrap img {
      width: 100% !important;
      max-width: 86% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
    }

    .bdmntn-feature {
      background: #050505;
    }

    .bdmntn-feature img {
      object-position: center 45%;
    }

    .bdmntn-gallery {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.35fr .65fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .bdmntn-shot,
    .bdmntn-format-card {
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid #e4e9f1;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff;
    }

    .bdmntn-shot-wide {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    .bdmntn-shot {
      margin: 0;
    }

    .bdmntn-shot img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 380px;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      display: block;
    }

    .bdmntn-shot-wide img {
      height: 430px;
    }

    .bdmntn-shot figcaption {
      padding: 18px 20px 20px;
      background: #fff;
    }

    .bdmntn-shot figcaption span {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      color: #ff6d35;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
    }

    .bdmntn-shot figcaption strong {
      display: block;
      color: #172033;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .bdmntn-format-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 34px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(145deg,#111,#080808);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .bdmntn-format-card span {
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      color: #ff7a3f;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .14em;
    }

    .bdmntn-format-card strong {
      color: #fff;
      font-size: clamp(27px,3.2vw,42px);
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
    }

    .bdmntn-format-card p {
      margin-top: 18px;
      color: #b9bec8;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* Equal rhythm for impact footer */
    .case-impact-banner,
    .case-highlight {
      min-height: 150px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* Mobile */
    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .project-modal-content .case-study-card {
        --case-gap-lg: 26px;
        padding: 30px 22px !important;
      }

      .case-study-head,
      .case-study-top,
      .case-top {
        min-height: 0;
      }

      .case-content-block,
      .case-section,
      .case-sections > .case-section {
        min-height: 0;
      }

      .case-photo-feature {
        min-height: 0;
        max-height: none;
      }

      .bdmntn-gallery {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .bdmntn-shot-wide {
        grid-column: auto;
      }

      .bdmntn-shot img,
      .bdmntn-shot-wide img {
        height: auto;
        max-height: 520px;
        object-fit: contain;
        background: #050505;
      }
    }

    /* BDMNTN XL FRONT CARD FINAL */
    .project-card.bdmntn-front-card .project-logo-wrap {
      height: 220px !important;
      padding: 38px 48px !important;
      background: #050505 !important;
      display: flex !important;
      align-items: center !important;
      justify-content: center !important;
    }

    .project-card.bdmntn-front-card .project-logo-wrap img {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
      max-width: 88% !important;
      max-height: 120px !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
      object-position: center !important;
      display: block !important;
    }

    .project-card.bdmntn-front-card h3 {
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 20px 22px 22px !important;
    }

    .bdmntn-no-logo {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      min-height: 0 !important;
    }

    .bdmntn-no-logo .case-study-heading {
      max-width: 760px;
    }

    /* V10 FOOTER + BDMNTN + CIRCLE CHART POLISH */
    footer#contact { margin-top: 0 !important; }
    

    .bdmntn-gallery {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important;
    }
    .bdmntn-shot-wide {
      grid-column: 1 / -1 !important;
    }
    .bdmntn-format-card {
      min-height: 360px;
    }

    .project-card.circle-front-card .project-logo-wrap {
      background: #0a2e69 !important;
      padding: 36px !important;
    }
    .project-card.circle-front-card .project-logo-wrap img {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
      max-width: 72% !important;
      max-height: 150px !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
      filter: none !important;
    }

    .circle-detail-head {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      min-height: 0 !important;
    }
    .circle-detail-head > div:first-child {
      max-width: 780px;
    }

    .circle-event-meta {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 24px;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border: 1px solid #e4eaf2;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: #fbfcff;
    }
    .circle-event-meta span {
      color: #0757d5;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
    }
    .circle-event-meta strong {
      color: #172033;
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    .circle-photo-feature {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 390px;
      max-height: 480px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0b1020;
    }
    .circle-photo-feature img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 390px;
      max-height: 480px;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      display: block;
    }
    .circle-photo-feature::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 50% 0 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(4,10,24,.86));
    }
    .circle-photo-caption {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: 28px;
      right: 28px;
      bottom: 24px;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .circle-photo-caption span {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      color: #8ad9ff;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
    }
    .circle-photo-caption strong {
      display: block;
      max-width: 700px;
      font-size: 21px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .circle-photo-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .circle-photo-grid figure {
      margin: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid #e4eaf2;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff;
    }
    .circle-photo-grid img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 280px;
      display: block;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      background: #f2f5f9;
    }
    .circle-photo-grid figcaption {
      padding: 16px 18px 18px;
    }
    .circle-photo-grid figcaption span {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: #0757d5;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
    }
    .circle-photo-grid figcaption strong {
      color: #172033;
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    @media(max-width:850px){
      .circle-event-meta { flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-start; }
      .circle-photo-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .circle-photo-grid img { height: auto; max-height: 420px; object-fit: contain; }
      .circle-photo-feature, .circle-photo-feature img { min-height: 0; height: auto; max-height: none; }
    }

    /* ==========================================================
       V11 — SPOTV NOW PLATFORM STRATEGY + WTT EVENT MANAGEMENT
       ========================================================== */

    .project-card.spotvnow-front-card .project-logo-wrap {
      background: #070707 !important;
      padding: 34px 40px !important;
    }
    .project-card.spotvnow-front-card .project-logo-wrap img {
      max-width: 82% !important;
      max-height: 110px !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
    }

    .project-card.wtt-front-card .project-logo-wrap {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg,#15041f,#3b075f) !important;
      padding: 34px 38px !important;
    }
    .project-card.wtt-front-card .project-logo-wrap img {
      max-width: 88% !important;
      max-height: 145px !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
    }

    .spotvnow-logo-box {
      background: #070707 !important;
    }
    .spotvnow-logo-box img {
      max-width: 86% !important;
      max-height: 110px !important;
    }

    .wtt-logo-box {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg,#160420,#420870) !important;
    }
    .wtt-logo-box img {
      max-width: 90% !important;
      max-height: 145px !important;
    }

    .spotvnow-feature {
      background: #f3f5f8;
    }
    .spotvnow-feature img {
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #f3f5f8;
      padding: 14px;
    }
    .spotvnow-feature::after {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 40%,rgba(3,10,22,.88)) !important;
    }

    .spotvnow-web-gallery,
    .wtt-web-gallery {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
      gap: 16px;
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .spotvnow-web-shot,
    .wtt-web-shot {
      margin: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid #e4eaf2;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff;
    }

    .spotvnow-web-shot img,
    .wtt-web-shot img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 340px;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      background: #f4f6f9;
    }

    .spotvnow-web-shot figcaption,
    .wtt-web-shot figcaption {
      padding: 17px 18px 19px;
    }
    .spotvnow-web-shot figcaption span,
    .wtt-web-shot figcaption span {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      color: #0757d5;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
    }
    .spotvnow-web-shot figcaption strong,
    .wtt-web-shot figcaption strong {
      display: block;
      color: #172033;
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .wtt-feature {
      background: #12051c;
    }
    .wtt-feature img {
      object-fit: cover !important;
    }

    .wtt-web-gallery {
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr;
    }
    .wtt-wide {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }
    .wtt-wide img {
      height: 390px;
      object-fit: contain;
      background: #08080a;
    }

    .wtt-event-card {
      min-height: 340px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 34px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg,#170520,#3d0869);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .wtt-event-card span {
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      color: #e079ff;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
    }
    .wtt-event-card strong {
      font-size: clamp(26px,3vw,40px);
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
    }
    .wtt-event-card p {
      margin-top: 18px;
      color: #d1c4dd;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    @media(max-width:850px){
      .spotvnow-web-gallery,
      .wtt-web-gallery {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .wtt-wide { grid-column: auto; }
      .spotvnow-web-shot img,
      .wtt-web-shot img,
      .wtt-wide img {
        height: auto;
        max-height: 500px;
        object-fit: contain;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================
       V12 — GITHUB PAGES RELEASE CHECK / SPOTV NOW LOGO FIX
       ========================================================== */

    /* SPOTV NOW logo must sit on white to preserve the black wordmark */
    .project-card.spotvnow-front-card .project-logo-wrap {
      background: #ffffff !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e6ebf2 !important;
      padding: 34px 40px !important;
    }

    .project-card.spotvnow-front-card .project-logo-wrap img {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
      max-width: 82% !important;
      max-height: 110px !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
      object-position: center !important;
      filter: none !important;
    }

    .spotvnow-logo-box {
      background: #ffffff !important;
      border: 1px solid #e3e8f0 !important;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,.02);
    }

    .spotvnow-logo-box img {
      width: 100% !important;
      max-width: 86% !important;
      max-height: 110px !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
      filter: none !important;
    }

    /* Stable rendering while remote editorial/reference images load */
    .circle-photo-feature,
    .circle-photo-grid figure,
    .spotvnow-web-shot,
    .wtt-web-shot,
    .wtt-feature {
      background: #f3f6fa;
    }

    img {
      -webkit-user-drag: none;
    }

    /* Focus state for keyboard users / deployed site accessibility */
    a:focus-visible,
    button:focus-visible,
    .project-card:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(7,87,213,.35);
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    /* Avoid layout shift from project-card images */
    .project-logo-wrap img {
      display: block;
    }

    /* Print/export safety */
    @media print {
      .nav,
      .project-modal,
      .project-modal-close {
        display: none !important;
      }

      body {
        background: #fff !important;
      }
    }

    /* COMPETENCY POPUP */
    .competency-modal-card{padding:46px; background:#fff;}
    .competency-modal-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:88px 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:start;padding-bottom:28px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
    .competency-modal-no{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--blue);padding-top:8px;}
    .competency-modal-head h3{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,64px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:0;}
    .competency-modal-head p{margin-top:14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.75;max-width:760px;}
    .competency-modal-groups{display:grid;gap:34px;margin-top:34px;}
    .competency-modal-group{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px;}
    .competency-modal-group h4{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:14px;}
    .competency-project-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;}
    .competency-project-card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fbfcff;padding:18px 20px;min-height:92px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
    .competency-project-card strong{font-size:15px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink);}
    .competency-project-card span{margin-top:5px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted);}
    .competency-project-card.wide{grid-column:span 2;}
    @media(max-width:720px){.competency-modal-card{padding:26px 20px}.competency-modal-head{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}.competency-project-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.competency-project-card.wide{grid-column:auto}}


    /* =========================================================
       COMPETENCY POPUP — COMPACT ONE-SCREEN LAYOUT
       ========================================================= */
    .project-modal:has(.competency-modal-card) {
      padding: 18px 20px;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .project-modal.is-open:has(.competency-modal-card) { display: flex; }
    .project-modal:has(.competency-modal-card) .project-modal-inner {
      width: min(1180px, calc(100vw - 40px));
      max-height: calc(100vh - 36px);
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: auto;
    }
    .project-modal:has(.competency-modal-card) .project-modal-close {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      margin: 12px 12px -50px 0;
      top: 10px;
      font-size: 20px;
    }
    .competency-modal-card {
      padding: 28px 34px 30px;
    }
    .competency-modal-head {
      grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .competency-modal-no {
      font-size: 10px;
      padding-top: 5px;
    }
    .competency-modal-head h3 {
      font-size: clamp(27px, 3.1vw, 42px);
      line-height: 1.02;
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
    }
    .competency-modal-head p {
      margin-top: 8px;
      max-width: 900px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .competency-modal-groups {
      display: grid;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }
    .competency-modal-group {
      padding-top: 12px;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .competency-modal-group h4 {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: 10.5px;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }
    .competency-project-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      column-gap: 10px;
      row-gap: 8px;
    }
    .competency-project-card {
      min-height: 54px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .competency-project-card strong {
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .competency-project-card span {
      margin-top: 2px;
      font-size: 10.5px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    /* Same vertical rhythm for every competency section */
    .competency-modal-groups > .competency-modal-group {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      padding-top: 12px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 721px) and (max-height: 820px) {
      .project-modal:has(.competency-modal-card) { padding: 10px 16px; }
      .project-modal:has(.competency-modal-card) .project-modal-inner {
        max-height: calc(100vh - 20px);
      }
      .competency-modal-card { padding: 20px 28px 22px; }
      .competency-modal-head { padding-bottom: 12px; }
      .competency-modal-head h3 { font-size: clamp(25px, 2.8vw, 36px); }
      .competency-modal-head p { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.45; }
      .competency-modal-groups { gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; }
      .competency-modal-group { padding-top: 9px; }
      .competency-modal-group h4 { margin-bottom: 6px; }
      .competency-project-grid { row-gap: 6px; }
      .competency-project-card { min-height: 46px; padding: 7px 10px; }
      .competency-project-card strong { font-size: 12px; }
      .competency-project-card span { font-size: 10px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .competency-project-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .project-modal:has(.competency-modal-card) { display: none; padding: 10px; align-items: flex-start; }
      .project-modal.is-open:has(.competency-modal-card) { display: flex; }
      .project-modal:has(.competency-modal-card) .project-modal-inner { width: 100%; max-height: calc(100vh - 20px); }
      .competency-modal-card { padding: 22px 18px 24px; }
      .competency-modal-head { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 5px; padding-bottom: 12px; }
      .competency-modal-head h3 { font-size: 28px; }
      .competency-project-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 6px; }
      .competency-project-card { min-height: 0; }
    }

    /* V14 — COMPETENCY POPUP tighter vertical rhythm */
    .competency-modal-group {
      padding: 8px 0 0 !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
    }
    .competency-modal-groups {
      gap: 10px !important;
      margin-top: 10px !important;
    }
    .competency-modal-group h4 {
      margin: 0 0 6px !important;
    }
    .competency-project-grid {
      column-gap: 8px !important;
      row-gap: 6px !important;
    }
    .competency-project-card {
      min-height: 48px !important;
      padding: 7px 11px !important;
    }
    .competency-project-card strong {
      font-size: 12.5px !important;
      line-height: 1.25 !important;
    }
    .competency-project-card span {
      margin-top: 2px !important;
      font-size: 10.5px !important;
      line-height: 1.25 !important;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .competency-modal-group { padding: 8px 0 0 !important; }
    }

/* === 03 PROJECTS V2 — logo visibility + consistent card media === */
#projects .project-v3-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;}
#projects .project-v3-card{min-height:300px;}
#projects .project-logo-wrap{min-height:185px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;}
#projects .project-logo-wrap img{max-width:82%;max-height:135px;object-fit:contain;}
#projects .logo-bg-bluerun{background:#fff !important;}
#projects .logo-bg-kbl,
#projects .logo-bg-baseball,
#projects .logo-bg-fashion{background:#fff !important;}
#projects .logo-bg-viewing{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#091f4e,#0b2f69 62%,#163f82);}
#projects .logo-bg-lotte{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#111827,#1f2937);}
.project-combo-logo{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.project-combo-logo img{max-width:36% !important;max-height:88px !important;}
.project-combo-logo .combo-x{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:#6b7280;}
.project-combo-logo.dark .combo-x{color:#cbd5e1;}
.project-combo-logo .spotv-word{font-size:clamp(46px,6vw,74px);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.06em;color:#fff;line-height:1;}

.portfolio-project-case .pp-panel.result li{color:#d9e5f7;}
.portfolio-project-case .pp-result-hero{display:block;margin:1px 0 10px;color:#fff;font-size:clamp(23px,2.5vw,34px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.03em;}
.portfolio-project-case .pp-feature-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:2px;}

.portfolio-project-case .pp-media{

.portfolio-project-case .pp-media figure.single img{min-height:330px;max-height:420px;}
.portfolio-project-case .pp-media figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:34px 16px 14px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(3,12,28,.86));color:#fff;font-size:10px;line-height:1.45;}

.competency-modal-no{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--blue);padding-top:7px;}

const projectCases = {
  nationals: "case-nationals",
  shownote: "case-shownote","soopers": "case-soopers", "race": "case-race", "bdmntn": "case-bdmntn", "circle": "case-circle", "bluerun": "case-bluerun", "spotvnow": "case-spotvnow", "lotte": "case-lotte"};

let projectModal;
let projectModalContent;

function ensureModalRefs() {
  if (!projectModal) projectModal = document.getElementById("projectModal");
  if (!projectModalContent) projectModalContent = document.getElementById("projectModalContent");
  return Boolean(projectModal && projectModalContent);
}

function openCompetency(key) {
  if (!ensureModalRefs()) return;
  const data = (document.documentElement.lang === "en" ? competencyDataEn : competencyDataKo)[key];
  if (!data) return;

  const groups = data.groups.map(group => {
    const company = group.title.startsWith("SOOP") ? "SOOP" : (group.title.startsWith("SPOTV") ? "SPOTV" : "");
    const tag = company ? `<div class="competency-company-tag ${company === "SPOTV" ? "spotv" : ""}">${company}</div>` : ``;
    return `
    <section class="competency-modal-group">
      ${tag}
      <h4 data-company="${company}">${group.title}</h4>
      <div class="competency-project-grid">
        ${group.items.map(item => `
          <div class="competency-project-card">
            <strong>${item[0]}</strong>
            ${item[1] ? `<span>${item[1]}</span>` : ``}
          </div>`).join("")}
      </div>
    </section>`;
  }).join("");

  projectModalContent.innerHTML = `
    <article class="competency-modal-card">
      <div class="competency-modal-head">
        <div class="competency-modal-no">${data.no} / COMPETENCY</div>
        <div>
          <h3>${data.title}</h3>
          <p>${data.desc}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="competency-modal-groups">${groups}</div>
    </article>`;

  projectModal.classList.add("is-open");
  projectModal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
  document.body.classList.add("modal-open");
  projectModal.scrollTop = 0;
}

function openProject(key) {
  if (!ensureModalRefs()) return;
  const sourceId = projectCases[key];
  const source = sourceId ? document.getElementById(sourceId) : null;
  if (!source) return;

  projectModalContent.innerHTML = "";
  const clone = source.cloneNode(true);
  clone.removeAttribute("id");
  clone.classList.remove("active");
  projectModalContent.appendChild(clone);

  projectModal.classList.add("is-open");
  projectModal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
  document.body.classList.add("modal-open");
  projectModal.scrollTop = 0;

  if (window.setPortfolioLanguage) {
    window.setPortfolioLanguage(document.documentElement.lang || "ko");
  }
}

function closeProject() {
  if (!ensureModalRefs()) return;
  projectModal.classList.remove("is-open");
  projectModal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  document.body.classList.remove("modal-open");
  projectModalContent.innerHTML = "";
}

function bindPortfolioInteractions() {
  ensureModalRefs();
  document.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
    const comp = event.target.closest(".competency-button[data-competency-key]");
    if (comp) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); openCompetency(comp.dataset.competencyKey); return; }
    const card = event.target.closest("#projects .project-card[data-project-key]");
    if (card) { event.preventDefault(); openProject(card.dataset.projectKey); return; }
    if (event.target === projectModal) closeProject();
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) {
    if (event.key === "Escape") closeProject();
    const card = event.target.closest && event.target.closest("#projects .project-card[data-project-key]");
    if (card && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) { event.preventDefault(); openProject(card.dataset.projectKey); }
  });
}

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", bindPortfolioInteractions);
} else {
  bindPortfolioInteractions();
}

</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const buttons = () => document.querySelectorAll(".lang-btn");

  function applyLanguage(lang){
    root.lang = lang;
    document.querySelectorAll(".i18n-text").forEach(el => {
      const next = el.getAttribute(lang === "en" ? "data-en" : "data-ko");
      if (next !== null) el.textContent = next;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-alt-ko]").forEach(el => {
      el.alt = el.getAttribute(lang === "en" ? "data-alt-en" : "data-alt-ko") || "";
    });
    buttons().forEach(btn => {
      const active = btn.dataset.lang === lang;
      btn.classList.toggle("active", active);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    });
    try { localStorage.setItem("portfolioLang", lang); } catch (e) {}

    // Refresh competency modal immediately if one is open.
    const modalContentNow = document.getElementById("projectModalContent");
    const openComp = modalContentNow ? modalContentNow.querySelector(".competency-modal-card") : null;
    if (openComp) closeProject();
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", e => {
    const btn = e.target.closest(".lang-btn");
    if (!btn) return;
    applyLanguage(btn.dataset.lang);
  });

  let initial = "ko"; try { initial = localStorage.getItem("portfolioLang") || "ko"; } catch (e) {}
  applyLanguage(initial);
  window.setPortfolioLanguage = applyLanguage;
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
